title: Degree-zero localization of sections on an affine scheme
statement: Let $Y$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], let $s\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L)$, and let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Define $H^0_*(Y,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbb Z}\Gamma(Y,\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$ with the tensor-power convention for negative $n$, and let $H^0_*(Y,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}$ be the degree-zero part of its localization at the homogeneous element $s$ of degree $1$. If $Y_s$ is the nonvanishing locus of $s$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], then the canonical map $H^0_*(Y,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}\to\Gamma(Y_s,\mathcal F|_{Y_s})$ sending a fraction $\xi/s^n$ to $s^{-n}\xi$ is an isomorphism.
